properties.name: Reasoning is attached to the structure it justifies: a requirement's reason to exist, an edge's argument, and circular delivery
properties.rationale: Built for req:an-edge-names-the-claim-that-argues-for-it-and-a-governed-requirement-reads-its-reason-to-exist (Anthony, 2026-10-18, choosing C of the build list), req:a-derived-requirement-inherits-its-reasoning-from-the-decision-that-created-it (items 1-3) and item 3 of req:a-choice-that-rests-on-checkable-premises-is-recorded-as-a-chain, from cases 2 and 4 of fact:reasoning-embedded-in-a-traditional-design-works-within-one-design-and-stops-at-premises-with-no-truth-and-at-design-borders-2026-10-18, which measured each gap; no cause is asserted beyond that measurement. Choices made: (1) the typed link is an edge PROPERTY, argued_by, declared node_ref (the existing typed-reference declaration, extended from node properties to edge properties), not a new edge type: an edge cannot end at an edge, and an edge property is not in the schema stamp, so the stamp does not move. Declared on SATISFIES and DEPENDS_ON only; another edge type can declare it later. (2) No lineage value added: derived's meaning is clarified to cover the owner's words chosen through a Decision; the value set, and so the stamp, is unchanged. (3) reasons_to_exist_lost names every Requirement a broken Decision governs, each with its lineage, and the note says a derived one loses its reason to exist while an original one loses a Decision that shapes it. (4) Circular means the target holds only through the edge's own delivery (no other satisfier, no holding step of its own, children not all delivered, not met, not taken as given). (5) reasoning_report does not walk into the governing Decision's chain from a requirement, so the requirement never reads as resting on it (why it exists and whether it is met stay two claims). (6) satisfies now merges an existing edge's properties instead of replacing them. Worked example on the live design: req:a-near-match-across-types-or-within-a-line-of-reasoning-is-a-note-not-a-refusal set lineage derived (its GOVERNED_BY note had left it original for want of the word). argued_by on the live SATISFIES edge waits for a flo2.io release carrying this schema. 12 MCP class tests over six designs; 11 observed failing on main b639be8 first. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Phase 2 of the 2026-10-18 build list. A Requirement GOVERNED_BY a Decision reads reason_to_exist on get_node and in reasoning_report (each Decision's acceptance and chain verdict, apart from delivery). propagate_from / propagate_change name every requirement losing its reason to exist (reasons_to_exist_lost) and every edge losing its argument (arguments_lost). SATISFIES and DEPENDS_ON declare argued_by, a node reference to the claim that argues for the edge, read beside it (argument, argues_for); satisfies takes evidence and argued_by, depends_on argued_by, and a re-draw keeps what the edge carried. A claim resting on the target's delivery along its own edge reads circular. derived lineage covers the owner's words chosen through a Decision. The served skills say how to record both.
